claims.text: As-fabricated additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi typically has an inhomogeneous microstructure.
As-fabricated additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi typically exhibits compositional segregation.
As-fabricated additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi typically contains high residual thermal stress and internal defects.
HPHT post-processing will reduce segregation, residual stress, and defects while improving the mechanical integrity of additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi.
A treatment near 1100–1150°C and approximately 1 GPa is an appropriate candidate processing window for AlCrFeNiSi.
The proposed treatment is applicable to additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi having a near-eutectic solid solution.
HPHT temperature, pressure, and dwell time require optimization because HPHT can produce complex microstructural evolution.
Improper HPHT parameters could induce deleterious phase transformations in AlCrFeNiSi.
Combined high temperature and pressure promote atomic diffusion and lattice rearrangement.
HPHT homogenizes the lamellar microstructure and reduces grain-boundary segregation in AlCrFeNiSi.
HPHT relaxes residual stresses in additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi.
Elevated temperature enables diffusion that heals defects and redistributes segregated elements.
High pressure suppresses excessive volume changes and drives formation of a uniform microstructure.
Mitigating defects and stress concentrations can reduce cracking and improve mechanical performance.
HPHT-treated AlCrFeNiSi will have greater tensile strength than untreated additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi.
HPHT-treated AlCrFeNiSi will have greater tensile ductility than untreated additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi.
HPHT-treated AlCrFeNiSi will show reduced compositional segregation and residual stress relative to untreated additively manufactured material.

contradictions.description: The predicted outcome uses untreated additively manufactured samples as the comparator, whereas the baseline alternatively names either conventionally fabricated material or as-built additive-manufactured material. These are distinct baselines and make the requested relative outcome ambiguous.
